title: Joint (7/2, 1) bound for the fixed BK/Shoup family via the 3.5n-7d affine-disperser theorem

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"Total family f_n on {0,1}^n for every integer n>=0. Set f_0=0. For n>=1 let k be the least prime strictly greater than 2*n^(3/5), r=ceil(n/k), t=ceil(sqrt(r)), m=r*k. Fix once a deterministic Shoup algorithm that on input the prime k in unary outputs a monic irreducible q_k in F_2[Z] of degree k in time polynomial in k. Let K=F_2[Z]/(q_k) with basis 1,Z,...,Z^(k-1). Pad x with m-n zeros and split it into r consecutive blocks of k bits; read block i as an element phi_i(x) of K, its first bit being the constant coefficient (an injective F_2-linear map). Let pi:K->F_2 be the constant-coefficient map. For 1<=i<=r put y_i=phi_i(x)^(2^(i+1)-1) and set f_n(x)=pi(Sym_r^t(y_1,...,y_r)), where Sym_r^t is the sum of the products over all t-element subsets of {1,...,r}. This is a single deterministic uniformly defined total family with no per-length advice.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"2","numerator":"7"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"2","numerator":"7"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"Let d(n)=floor(12*m(n)^(4/5))+1 with m(n) as in the family. For every sufficiently large integer n, every deterministic acyclic fan-in-two circuit over the full binary basis B_2 that computes f_n on all 2^n inputs has at least (7/2)*n - 7*d(n) = (7/2)*n - O(n^(4/5)) gates. Since d(n)=O(n^(4/5))=o(n), liminf as n tends to infinity of C_B2(f_n)/n is at least 7/2 in the full Li-Yang B2 model at actual input length n. The family is in P, hence in NP with empty witnesses, and the language, verifier and witness bound are fixed for all lengths.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}
